items.claim: Steve Erceg struggled against Tim Elliott and was nearly knocked out by Ode Osbourne.
items.quote: Oh, you beat a 49-year-old Tim Elliott who took a round off of you... You beat Ode' Osbourne because he had no takedown defense whatsoever.

items.claim: Steve Erceg was knocked out by Kai Kara-France.
Steve Erceg is a decent wrestler who has added striking and possesses high fight IQ.
items.quote: Steve Erceg is a decent wrestler who has evolved, added some striking, and I think he's high IQ.

items.claim: Magomed Ankalaev uses his length well, has technical striking, good forward pressure, and uses wrestling as a backup plan.
items.quote: He's long, he uses length pretty well. He has wrestling as a backup plan. It is squarely plan B, not plan A. But he's a long dude. He's got good technical striking, good forward pressure.

items.claim: Magomed Ankalaev was sick or injured going into his recent fight against Alex Pereira.
items.quote: What was he? Sick or injured, whatever it was going into his last fight, I believe it.
